Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar
Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados por um propósito compartilhado de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, contamos com um portfólio diversificado de marcas e soluções, em diferentes países da América Latina, que contemplam todas as fases da jornada do morar e ainda um Hub de Tecnologia em Portugal. Desenvolvemos tecnologias e inovação para transformar e impulsionar a experiência de moradia como um todo.
Com o apoio de uma equipe de classe mundial de investidores e consultores, como Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic e SoftBank, o Grupo QuintoAndar está atualmente avaliado em mais de US$ 5,1 bilhões e continua a crescer ano após ano.

Sobre a Área
O time de Inside Sales Outbound (Carteirização) é uma operação jovem, dinâmica e de alta performance criada no final de 2024 dentro do Grupo QuintoAndar. Nossa missão é acelerar a captação e a publicação de imóveis na plataforma através do contato ativo com proprietários que iniciaram, mas não finalizaram seus cadastros.

Atuamos sob um modelo estratégico de carteirização por squads, onde cada analista gerencia sua própria base de leads em ciclos de até 30 dias utilizando discador e WhatsApp. É uma área focada em metas desafiadoras, execução impecável e ritmo acelerado.
Responsabilidades
Prospecção Ativa (Outbound): Realizar o contato diário via discador e WhatsApp com proprietários com o objetivo de convertê-los e garantir que anunciem seus imóveis (aluguel e venda) na plataforma.
Gestão de Carteira (Carteirização): Administrar e nutrir uma carteira exclusiva de leads por ciclos de até 30 dias, aplicando réguas de relacionamento e fluxos de cadência ( follow-ups ).
Contorno de Objeções: Atuar com técnicas de vendas diretas e de impacto para desatar nós burocráticos e contornar as dores dos proprietários de forma assertiva e ágil.
Foco em Indicadores: Garantir o atingimento e a superação dos KPIs diários e mensais da operação (volume de ligações, tempo logado, taxa de conversão de anúncios).
Esgotamento de Base: Executar com disciplina o funil de vendas focado em eficiência, priorizando contatos com maior potencial sem deixar oportunidades esquecidas.
Requisitos
Perfil Resolutivo: Experiência comprovada em vendas ativas ( Outbound ), telemarketing ativo, retenção ou cobrança. Perfil resiliente que lide muito bem com metas agressivas e cobrança por indicadores.
Conforto com Volume Operacional: Experiência prévia em rotinas estruturadas com uso intensivo de discadores automáticos e metas de volume de ligações diárias.
Autonomia e Organização: Capacidade de autogestão para gerenciar a carteira de leads sem necessidade de monitoramento constante da liderança.
Comunicação de Impacto: Excelente desenvoltura verbal, velocidade de raciocínio para contornar objeções e clareza para transmitir propostas de valor ao telefone.
Diferenciais
Diferenciais: Experiência em operações de vendas de alta performance de startups ou grandes empresas de tecnologia.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.
As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative.

This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.
Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association
meetups.
This role covers the South East region in North Dakota, ideally in Fargo. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattlemans, Stockmans associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

You’ll be great if you exhibit
Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

Chi siamo
Le banche tradizionali non ti hanno mai dato pieno controllo della tua vita finanziaria. Satispay esiste per cambiare le cose: per mettere il potere della finanza nelle mani delle persone .
Questo significa rendere i servizi finanziari semplici e accessibili per oltre 6,5M di utenti. Abbiamo iniziato dai pagamenti, poi i benefit, gli investimenti, le carte… e non abbiamo finito. Anzi, siamo solo all’inizio. Ogni volta seguiamo la stessa logica: trovare un problema reale, risolverlo come si deve e passare al successivo. La destinazione?

Costruire la piattaforma finanziaria più amata al mondo. Se ti prendi la responsabilità dei risultati e non solo dei compiti, se resti accanto a ciò di cui le persone hanno bisogno e non aspetti che siano gli altri a sistemare quello che non funziona — qui troverai persone che lavorano esattamente come te.

E insieme costruirete qualcosa di cui essere fieri.
Il Recruiting Day di Satispay 🚀
Il 10 e il 16 settembre non prendere impegni! C’è il Business Development Recruiting Day di Satispay!
Se hai appena terminato gli studi (o ti manca poco!), oppure vuoi dare una scossa al tuo percorso lavorativo e iniziare una brillante carriera nel mondo del business development, non puoi perderti questo evento! Il Recruiting Day è l’occasione perfetta per conoscerci e avviare insieme il tuo futuro lavorativo 🚀

10 settembre - online event (Tieni libera tutta la giornata, che sarà strutturata in due momenti):
Presentazione plenaria online (inizio ore 10.00): Un momento per conoscerci e scoprire tutto su Satispay e sul ruolo di Inside Business Development.
Colloqui individuali online (dalle 11:30 in poi): Lo stesso giorno, dalle 11:30 alle 18:00 circa, si terranno i colloqui individuali. Ti daremo indicazione precisa dell'orario del tuo colloquio nei giorni precedenti!
16 settembre - onsite event : Incontro e colloquio finale con il Team Business Development presso i nostri uffici di Napoli.
Se dopo l'intervista individuale i feedback di entrambe le parti saranno positivi, ti inviteremo nel nostro ufficio di Napoli per partecipare ad una giornata composta di due momenti:
Job Shadowing Experience: Un'esperienza esclusiva in cui avrai modo di sederti fianco a fianco con colleghi e colleghe del Business Development Team per toccare con mano cosa significa essere Business Developer in Satispay.
Colloquio finale di persona con i responsabili del Business Development: Un momento di valutazione finale sull'allineamento alla cultura e ai valori di Satispay!
Cosa farai con noi
In qualità di Sales Development Representative, Welfare, sarai la persona chiave per espandere il nostro network, gestendo le relazioni commerciali e promuovendo l'adozione delle soluzioni Satispay.

Generare lead qualificati - attraverso attività outbound ad alto volume, come cold calling ed email outreach.
Sviluppare nuove opportunità di business - entrando in contatto con HR, decision maker e stakeholder aziendali per presentare Satispay come soluzione welfare di riferimento.
Supportare il team Business Development - costruendo una pipeline solida di prospect mid-market ed enterprise.
Utilizzare strumenti CRM e di prospecting - come Salesforce, HubSpot, Sales Navigator e Lusha - per monitorare attività, pipeline e performance commerciali.
Collaborare a stretto contatto con il team commerciale - per raggiungere e superare gli obiettivi di lead generation e contribuire alla crescita della business line Welfare.
Chi stiamo cercando
Per questo ruolo cerchiamo una persona intraprendente, che ami il lavoro di squadra e sappia passare all'azione, con forte curiosità e senso di responsabilità sui propri progetti.
Intraprendenza - Candidati neolaureati, neodiplomati o alle prime esperienze che vogliano mettersi alla prova e gettare le basi per una carriera nel Business Development, oppure profili professionali che desiderano dare una svolta alla propria carriera e non hanno paura di rimettersi in gioco, ricominciando da un ruolo junior.
Doti relazionali - Abilità di instaurare un rapporto di fiducia in modo positivo e professionale con diversi interlocutori.
Capacità persuasive - Sicurezza nell’approcciare ed ingaggiare potenziali nuovi utenti o clienti tramite chiamate.
Orientamento all’obiettivo - Capacità di concentrarsi sul risultato, individuando strategie alternative per il perseguimento di obiettivi mensili.
Comunicazione strutturata - Abilità di comunicare in modo strutturato e convincente, riuscendo ad adattare facilmente il proprio stile comunicativo in base al contesto.
Non preoccuparti se non ti riconosci in ogni singolo requisito. Crediamo nella forza di prospettive e talenti diversi. Il tuo punto di vista è importante mentre costruiamo qualcosa di speciale: se hai passione e pensi di poter fare la differenza, ti incoraggiamo a candidarti.
CareAbout: come supportiamo il tuo impatto
Andiamo veloci e la nostra evoluzione non si ferma mai. È un percorso entusiasmante, ma può essere sfidante. Per assicurarci che le nostre persone possano dare il meglio di sé, ci impegniamo a semplificare la loro vita, sia in ufficio che fuori.

❤️ Salute: assicurazione privata per te e la tua famiglia, supporto psicologico con Serenis, workshop sul benessere mentale.
💰 Risorse finanziarie: piano di Stock Option, Buoni Pasto, supporto al trasferimento se cambi Paese.
⚙️ Crescita e sviluppo: programmi di formazione professionale, mobilità interna, corsi di lingua con Preply
🌱 Flessibilità: ferie illimitate, policy di lavoro ibrido*, orari flessibili.
👨‍👩‍👧 Famiglia: congedo parentale esteso, permessi extra per malattia dei figli.
*Prevediamo tre giorni a settimana in ufficio (martedì, giovedì + 1 altro giorno a tua scelta), con la possibilità di richiedere periodi extra di lavoro da remoto.
Offriamo un contratto iniziale di 6 mesi.
Stipendio iniziale: €25,000 - €32,000 lordi all'anno + variabile
Questi valori sono definiti sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere, in linea con i requisiti fondamentali della posizione. Tuttavia, crediamo che non si debba imporre un limite al talento. Il pacchetto retributivo finale sarà personalizzato in base alla tua esperienza e alle tue competenze uniche. Se ritieni che il tuo profilo vada oltre i requisiti standard, ti invitiamo a candidarti comunque: saremo felici di valutare insieme un'offerta che rifletta il tuo reale valore.
Come funziona la selezione?
1️⃣ Invia la tua candidatura entro il 4 settembre 2026 ✉️
2️⃣ Primo contatto: Il Talent Acquisition Team ti contatterà via email entro 7 giorni dall'invio del tuo CV per fissare un breve colloquio telefonico 📞
3️⃣ Partecipa al Recruiting Day: Se il primo colloquio avrà esito positivo, avrai un posto assicurato per partecipare al Recruiting Day.
Pari opportunità
In Satispay, siamo orgogliosi di offrire pari opportunità a chiunque. Valorizziamo la diversità e l'inclusione, accogliendo persone di ogni background. Questa posizione è aperta a tutti, indipendentemente - ad esempio - da etnia, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale o provenienza.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
Help Win New Business

Operating at the intersection of logistics and tech has allowed Flexport to develop a unique value proposition that customers all over the globe love, resulting in exponential growth over the last 10+ years. Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelter Bonus – kein Deckel, keine gestaffelten Bremsen. Was du holst, bekommst du.

Kurze Wege – direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kollegiale und leistungsorientierte Atmosphäre. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einer Schublade.

Du gewinnst die Projekte

Du pflegst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielgerichtet auf deine KPIs hin.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal ’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
The International segment is seeking a new Business Development Representative (BDR) to help generate a quality pipeline for our Account Executives focused on our Regional-Mid-Market business segment. You will help build the pipeline by strategically prospecting and nurturing opportunities in accounts with 15-500 locations.

This role is a great opportunity to develop outbound and phone skills by delivering a consultative platform pitch to C-suite, VP, and Director level positions across departments like IT, Operations, Accounting/Finance & Marketing.

You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with varied future customers and personalized training and career opportunities.
You will gain exposure to the Enterprise sales process and work cross-functionally with many segments of our team, including Senior Management, Marketing, Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, Services & Support, etc. You will also work closely with seasoned Account Executives to develop targeted prospecting strategies in their assigned markets.

Generate new business pipeline primarily through outbound prospecting (2+ new business qualified sales opportunities per month)
Gain interest through outbound cold calling across a set of accounts/prospects and breaking into net new logos in assigned territory (65+ activities per day)
Schedule discovery calls, demos, on-sites and follow-up calls (owning the process until calls or meetings occur)
Leverage existing tools and research to find new contacts to develop your call-base
Focused efforts promoting new products to prospects
Multi-threading and account mapping within large restaurant brands corporate teams and franchisees
Persistent, organized follow-up with nurture contacts/accounts to re-engage on a next step (bring them back to the table!)
Entering activity, notes, company account info and updating opportunities in Salesforce
Work effectively with assigned AEs on a daily/weekly/monthly basis on maintaining target account lists and prospecting strategies
Provide input in the design of & help in the execution of enterprise marketing efforts (campaigns, trade-shows, etc)
Get the prep off your plate. Continuously find the repetitive parts of the day: account research, list building, note-taking, follow-up drafting and get them off your plate so more of your day is spent in live conversation.
Prioritize on evidence, not list order. Work accounts based on observable change in the business: expansion, new openings, ownership change, hiring patterns, guest feedback trends, visible technology — rather than dialing top to bottom.
Disqualify fast, remove closed brands, duplicates, wrong-segment accounts and dead numbers from the working list so your dial time concentrates on accounts that can actually convert.
Protect the data everything runs on. Keep account and contact records accurate, current and deduplicated, understanding that routing, scoring and every AI-assisted workflow is only as good as the data underneath it.
Find the person who actually decides. Resolve messy ownership structures — franchise groups, multiple legal entities, operators running several concepts under different names to reach a real decision maker rather than a main line.
Open on their situation, not our product. Lead with something specific and verifiable about the operator's business, and recognize that many operators have been burned by a previous vendor.
Close the loop on what's broken. Flag bad numbers, wrong contacts and research that didn't hold up, so the target lists get better for you and for the AEs you support rather than quietly eroding.

s.h: ## VOTRE RÔLE - CE QUI VOUS ATTEND ##
s.t:
* **Direction d'équipe :** Vous dirigez une équipe d'ingénierie de test, la développez continuellement et favorisez la collaboration. Vous coordonnez les missions de projet de vos membres d'équipe.
* **Gestion du personnel :** Vous vous occupez du recrutement, du développement et de la fidélisation des collaborateurs.
* **Développement :** Vous faites avancer les stratégies de test internes d'adesso sur des sujets actuels tels que l'automatisation des tests, les tests assistés par IA ou les technologies cloud.
* **Veille du marché et analyse des tendances :** Vous observez le marché et les tendances actuelles et développez des idées pour des innovations produits.
* **Relations clients :** Vous développez continuellement votre réseau client, êtes l'interlocuteur direct de nos clients et êtes opérationnellement impliqué dans les projets. Vous conseillez les clients de manière stratégique et méthodologique sur toutes les questions liées aux tests.
* **Travail de projet :** Selon votre profil, vous apportez votre expertise en tant que test manager, automatisateur de tests, analyste métier (BA), product owner (PO) ou ingénieur des exigences (RE) et assumez des rôles de leadership dans les projets chez le client.
* **Conseil stratégique et méthodologique :** L'optimisation des processus métier ainsi que la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions informatiques sont au cœur de votre activité.

s.h: ## VOS COMPÉTENCES - CE QUE VOUS APPORTER ##
s.t:
**Consultant IT senior / manager avec affinité pour les tests**
* **Diplôme achevé** en informatique (économique) ou formation IT comparable ou expérience professionnelle IT
* **Expérience significative** en tant qu'analyste métier, product owner ou ingénieur des exigences dans des projets IT
* **Intérêt marqué et affinité** pour les tests et l'assurance qualité - des connaissances en automatisation des tests sont un plus mais pas obligatoires
* **Disponibilité et flexibilité** pour être déployé chez le client selon les besoins en tant que BA, PO ou RE
**Ce que vous apportez indépendamment du profil**
* **Expérience :** Bonnes capacités conceptuelles et analytiques ainsi qu'une forte communication et une compréhension rapide. Votre attitude est convaincante et assurée.
* **Qualités de leadership :** Vous avez une première expérience de gestion ou souhaitez évoluer vers un rôle de leader et construire et développer une équipe.
* **Communication :** Vous appréciez l'échange constant avec toutes les parties prenantes, êtes socialement compétent et communiquez de manière assurée et adaptée au public.
* **Compétences linguistiques :** Vous parlez très bien l'allemand (C1) et couramment l'anglais (B2) et êtes prêt à voyager.

Fernab des klassischen Garagen\- und Händlerkonzepts setzt das Unternehmen auf einen digitalen Ansatz, weitgehend automatisierte Prozesse sowie eine leistungsorientierte Unternehmenskultur, um ein modernes und zeitgemässes Kundenerlebnis zu bieten.
Getragen von einem jungen, dynamischen und ambitionierten Team vermarktet das Unternehmen ein breites Fahrzeugportfolio, das von Volumenmarken bis hin zu Premium\- und Luxusfahrzeugen reicht, und betreut Kundinnen und Kunden in der gesamten Schweiz.
Stellenbeschreibung
In einem agilen und leistungsstarken Team übernehmen Sie die von der Unternehmung generierten Verkaufschancen und begleiten Ihre Kundinnen und Kunden während des gesamten Kaufprozesses. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:
Bearbeitung und Qualifizierung eingehender Leads aus verschiedenen digitalen Kanälen.
Beratung und Begleitung der Kundinnen und Kunden bei ihrem Fahrzeugkauf.
Analyse der Kundenbedürfnisse und Ausarbeitung passender Lösungen.
Präsentation und Vermarktung eines vielseitigen Portfolios von Occasionen und neuwertigen Fahrzeugen.
Erstellung von Verkaufsangeboten, Finanzierungslösungen und Kaufverträgen.
Sicherstellung einer konsequenten Nachverfolgung aller Verkaufschancen im CRM\-System.
Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Kundenbeziehungen.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den internen Teams zur Gewährleistung eines erstklassigen Kundenerlebnisses.
Aktive Mitwirkung an den Wachstums\- und Entwicklungszielen des Unternehmens.
Profil
Organisiert, strukturiert und gewissenhaft arbeiten Sie gerne in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, in dem die Qualität der Umsetzung den Unterschied macht.
Sie beherrschen Deutsch und Englisch zwingend in Wort und Schrift. Französisch ist von Vorteil.
Sie sind in der Lage, mehrere Dossiers gleichzeitig zu betreuen und dabei eine präzise sowie reaktionsschnelle Kundenbetreuung sicherzustellen.
Sie arbeiten selbstständig und zeigen im Alltag Eigeninitiative.
Neugierig und proaktiv interessieren Sie sich für Ihren Markt, lernen gerne dazu und passen sich schnell an neue Situationen an.
Sie fühlen sich sowohl am Telefon als auch in persönlichen Kundengesprächen wohl.
Sie verfügen über eine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.
Erfahrung im Automobilverkauf ist ein klarer Vorteil, jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung.
Sie sind stärker durch die kommerzielle Herausforderung und das Erzielen von Resultaten motiviert als durch das Produkt selbst.
Sie sind versiert im Umgang mit IT\-Tools, CRM\-Systemen und digitalen Verkaufsumgebungen.
Sie schätzen ein dynamisches, unternehmerisches und leistungsorientiertes Umfeld.
Sie werden durch ambitionierte Ziele, Vertriebserfolg und Kundenzufriedenheit motiviert.

About Nivoda 🚀
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.
This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.
What will you be doing? 😎
Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.
Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.
Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.
Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.
Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.
Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.
What do we need from you? 💪
1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.
A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.
Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.
Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.
Native or professional proficiency in English is required for this role.
Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.
Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.
At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.
The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.
We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact.

We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
Support our team culture by working in the office 4 days a week (Monday - Thursday). This means you’ll have to live within commuting distance of the office you’ll be working in.
Snowflake is seeking motivated people with a passion for technology and the drive to build an incredible career in SaaS sales. The Sales Development team plays a critical role in the growth of our organization. Our team works in collaboration with sales and marketing nurturing leads and setting qualified discovery calls that ultimately lead to new business and new revenue.

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence.

Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500.

Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

The Sales Development team at AlphaSense sits at the front line of our company’s prospect engagement and pipeline generation efforts.

We identify potential prospects, leverage diverse outreach strategies, engage in strategic conversations with stakeholders, and collaborate with Account Executives with the goal of expanding our footprint within new and existing accounts and generating revenue for the organization.

At our core, we are a dynamic team of highly driven self-starters who are passionate about the AlphaSense product and rely on product and industry knowledge to communicate the value of our solution and convert interested prospects into qualified leads.

Sales Development Representatives at AlphaSense are fundamental to the success and growth of our business. You will focus on driving new business by sourcing, establishing and building relationships with Fortune 1000 executives or investment professionals over the phone, by email and through social outreach.

The SDR role at AlphaSense will provide you with the foundational expertise you need to not only excel in the role today but our training and development program will help to propel your career into a quota-carrying sales role .

Passionate about sales: Whether you have sales experience or are transitioning from another career/industry; you possess the drive and ambition to succeed
A strong communicator: You will regularly be interacting with senior level executives from some of the largest companies in the world -- your written, verbal and presentation skills need to be on point
Organized: You’ll be busy helping our sales team close major deals -- and you’ll need to keep yourself focused and on task
Growth minded: Our business is rapidly evolving and we want you to do the same. We will give you the training, tools and guidance necessary to succeed in a fast-paced environment; it’s up to you to apply that learning and grow with us
Goal-oriented: You will have specific KPIs by which we will measure your productivity on a consistent basis. When you see your goals, your first thought might be, “How do I beat it/surpass that target?” -- that’s what we’re looking for (and you’ll be compensated well for those efforts!)

Research and identify new client opportunities based on key client profiles in target accounts
Partner with our Account Executives on identifying new business opportunities in our clients and prospects -- our business is growing rapidly and there are tens of thousands of opportunities to uncover -- we’re trusting you with the responsibility of uncovering them!
Apply sales development best practices with email, phone and social outreach to connect with new prospects
Engage with prospects to articulate our product’s value proposition
Utilize discovery and objection handling strategies to speak knowledgeably with decision makers and to build interest in our offerings
Coordinate meetings on an account executive’s calendar and log activities in CRM
Demonstrate ability to consistently achieve or exceed program targets.
AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity.

AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor.

This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
Recruiting Scams and Fraud
We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:
AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
All official communications will come from an @ alpha-sense.com email address.
If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page .
If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets.

Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets.

Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description.

Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram .

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results!

Geotab is seeking a Senior Inside Sales professional who will spearhead the migration and upselling of our existing customer base to our new platform, before evolving into a full-cycle sales role driving revenue through our vehicle and asset tracking solutions.

If you love building lasting client relationships, closing complex deals, and making a measurable impact at an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

As a Senior Executive - Inside Sales, you will manage the full B2B sales cycle across new business acquisition and migration sales, working with limited supervision to prospect, qualify, demonstrate, propose, negotiate, and close opportunities across Geotab's fleet management and asset intelligence solutions.
You will manage inbound leads and execute targeted outbound prospecting strategies, maintaining a qualified pipeline through regular follow-up, accurate CRM activity logging, and reliable opportunity staging. You will conduct consultative discovery, build clear business cases, deliver product demonstrations, present tailored proposals, and negotiate pricing and deal terms.
You will support existing customers transitioning from the legacy platform to the new solution, identifying upsell and expansion opportunities during migration. You will partner with Finance, Marketing, Customer Support, Onboarding, and Implementation to deliver a seamless customer experience from first contact through onboarding, before completing a structured handover to Account Management.

Execute the full sales cycle across new business and migration opportunities, meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly quota targets.
Manage inbound leads and targeted outbound prospecting activity to maintain a consistent, qualified pipeline with sufficient coverage.
Conduct consultative discovery sessions with prospects and existing clients to understand business challenges, identify expansion opportunities, and map Geotab solutions to operational needs.
Deliver live video and, where appropriate, in-person product demonstrations, tailored proposals, and clear business cases to customer decision-makers.
Present and negotiate pricing, contract structures, and deal terms while managing objections and advancing complex opportunities to close.
Partner with Finance on pricing requests and contract structures, and collaborate with Marketing on targeted email and digital outreach campaigns.
Coordinate post-sale handover to Customer Onboarding, Customer Success, and Implementation, maintaining ownership through onboarding to support high customer satisfaction and fast time-to-value.
Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity stages, activity logs, pipeline updates, and weekly and monthly revenue forecasts for sales leadership.
Manage higher-complexity deals requiring advanced negotiation, multi-stakeholder coordination, and structured problem-solving, escalating unresolved issues to the Associate Director as needed.
Engage directly with customers and prospects on-site where required to advance opportunities.

s.h: What you'll bring to this role
s.t:
Post-secondary diploma or degree, or equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in a related field.
5-8 years of full-cycle B2B inside sales experience, including prospecting, qualification, demonstration, negotiation, and close.
A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota in a target-driven inside sales environment.
Strong consultative or solution-based selling skills, including structured discovery, business-case development, and persuasive solution positioning.
Experience with outbound prospecting and inbound lead conversion in an SMB or commercial sales environment.
Effective negotiation skills and confidence managing pricing objections, deal terms, and customer stakeholders in SMB organisations.
Proficiency in CRM platforms, preferably Salesforce, for pipeline management, opportunity staging, activity tracking, and revenue forecasting.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver compelling demonstrations, presentations, and written proposals remotely and in person.
A collaborative mindset and experience working cross-functionally with Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Customer Success, and Implementation teams.
Familiarity with fleet management, vehicle tracking, ELD compliance, or asset intelligence is a significant asset.
Technical competence using digital sales tools, including Google Suite and CRM or sales engagement tools.
Availability for occasional travel, including use of a personal vehicle for business purposes where required.
If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Manage complex and high-value client accounts to maximize revenue potential and strengthen Geotab's presence in enterprise segments.
Conduct inbound and outbound outreach, web demonstrations, and pricing negotiations to convert prospects into customers and move opportunities through the sales cycle.

Guide existing customers through the migration to the new platform to drive adoption, reduce churn, and protect recurring revenue.
Execute contracts via DocuSign to accelerate deal closure and reduce administrative friction in the sales process.
Collaborate with the Marketing team on email campaigns to generate pipeline, nurture prospects, and support lead conversion.
Sell vehicle and asset tracking solutions to achieve and exceed revenue targets across assigned accounts.
Coordinate with customer support, implementation, and deployment teams post-sale to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and high customer satisfaction.
Manage diverse account portfolios across multiple industries to drive retention, identify expansion opportunities, and grow account value.
Maintain accurate sales pipeline data and forecasting to support business planning and give leadership clear visibility into revenue performance.
Meet with customers and prospects in person to build trust, accelerate deal cycles, and strengthen long-term relationships.

Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired.

We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com.
